name: Nam
description: Personal notes and writing. A static Markdown blog. Public MCP read tools; writes open draft GitHub pull requests.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Fetch published Markdown by slug, path, or URL.

tools.name: validate_post
tools.description: Dry-run frontmatter and excerpt validation. No GitHub write.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a draft post and open a GitHub pull request. Always draft: true.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Update a post on a branch and open a pull request. draft: false requires posts:publish.

rate_limits.note: Machine-readable errors use code, message, retryable, retry_after.
